17 January, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Court No. - 90
Case :- Transfer Application (Criminal) No. - 459 of 2022
Applicant :- Ashok Kumar Rai And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Sanjay Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Shailendra Kumar Rai Hon'ble Om Prakash Tripathi,J.
Heard learned counsel for applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

This transfer application has been moved by the applicants for transfer of Criminal Appeal No. 7 of 2020 (Ashok Rai vs. State) under Sections 323, 504, 506 and 498A I.P.C., Police Station Jamaniya,
District Ghazipur, pending in the Court of Session Judge Ghazipur.

entities.text: Criminal Appeal No. 7 of 2020 (Ashok Rai vs. State)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The main submission is that opposite party no. 2 is practicing advocate and creates hindrance and pressure is disposal of the appeal.
Applicants have been convicted by the trial court.

No application has been given by the applicants against opposite party no. 2 before the Bar Council of Uttar Pradesh or before the District Judge or before the Court concerned regarding the hindrance.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, it is not a fit case for transfer.
Ground for transfer of the aforesaid case is insufficient and therefore transfer application is hereby rejected.
Inform to court concerned through Sessions Judge Ghazipur.
